density_carrier.canonical_closure: N_L(sigma,T) <<_{epsilon,L} T^{f0(sigma)+epsilon}; for zeta density hypothesis f0(sigma)=2(1-sigma)
density_carrier.scope: quantitative zero counts in right-half rectangles, not zero-location closure and not zero-spacing correlation

extension.statement: Beyond zero location, zero/coefficient correlations, and critical-line growth, Selberg-class cascades admit quantitative zero-count residuals in rectangles.
extension.canonical_target: Density hypothesis N(sigma,T) << T^{2(1-sigma)+epsilon} for 1/2<sigma<=1, with L-family variants.
extension.classification: parallel framework family: outside Riemann Dichotomy, SCDG, Cross-Correlation Extension, and Subconvexity Extension
